claims.evidence: The witness report does not confirm the import status or previous registration.
The witness identified it as a three-wheeled motor vehicle but could not confirm the brand or model.
Ownership and registration documents were not shown.
The witness saw the wheels but did not report on the tread depth or condition of the tires.
This contradicts the 'Tokunbo' (foreign used) claim and cannot be verified without purchase receipts.
The functional status of the vehicle and controls was not shown.

risks.risk: The vehicle may not be a genuine Can-Am Ryker, but a lower-value generic trike.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the manufacturer's VIN plate and branding badges.
risks.if_unproven: as a generic unbranded three-wheeled vehicle.

risks.risk: The engine or electrical system may be non-functional.
risks.proof: A video clip of the engine starting, idling, and the dashboard powering on.
risks.if_unproven: as a non-running unit for parts.

risks.risk: The vehicle may have been used locally despite the 'Tokunbo' claim, or have no legal papers.
risks.proof: Photos of the Customs Single Goods Declaration (SGD) and any local registration documents.
risks.if_unproven: as a vehicle without legal documentation.

proof_requests: Video of the engine starting and the vehicle moving forward and backward.
Close-up photo of the VIN/chassis number plate.
Photos of the dashboard showing the mileage/odometer.
Photos of the Customs duty papers and any registration documents.
Photo of the rear wheel and suspension assembly.
response.reason: The witness could not identify the brand or model, which is the primary driver of value. Furthermore, the seller's claims are contradictory, stating it is both 'Direct Tokunbo' (recently imported used) and 'Bought new 6 months ago'.
